name: AIHOT MCP
tagline: Read Chinese AI news, hot topics and daily, weekly or monthly briefs
description: Official read-only MCP endpoint for AIHOT, a Chinese-language AI news aggregator. Eight tools provide selected news, search over recent items, hot topics, story timelines, daily/weekly/monthly briefs, and Codex reset information. Connect directly over Streamable HTTP without an account or API key. Summaries include source links; verify claims against original sources. The code is MIT licensed; hosted news content follows https://aihot.news/terms.

install.notes: No sign-in or API key is required. Hosted content permits personal noncommercial and organizational internal reading; external commercial use or bulk republication requires written permission. See https://aihot.news/terms.
